_meta.purpose: Tier-1 keyword classification of AI response text into the audit severity enum. Bilingual (EN/FR) because AI narration follows the report language. Patterns are added over time from quarterly audit-log review WITHOUT code change, per design 6.5.4.6.
_meta.matching: Case-insensitive substring/regex match against the AI response text. The HIGHEST severity whose patterns match wins. Tier-2 structural (an explicit 'Severity: <LEVEL>' line in the response) overrides this entirely.
_meta.confidenceNote: A match on a SINGLE pattern of a SINGLE word is low-confidence and flags needs_human_review, per the design's confidence threshold. Multi-word or multi-pattern matches are treated as confident.

structuralDistressMarkers._note: These patterns indicate that the finding MIGHT be severe even if no severity keyword fired. When any of these is present but keyword classification produced a level below ACTION_REQUIRED, the result is NOT silently trusted: needs_human_review is set. This guards the design's default-to-ADVISORY rule against silently downgrading a genuinely critical finding phrased in vocabulary the keyword list does not yet cover. Aggregate accuracy can look healthy while this specific, dangerous error slips through; this catches it.
